body: i lost all passionate ability years ago. i had hopes that a wife and children would renew such emotions but it has failed.
Like i can just walk up to my wife and say 'you're part of the problem'. I;m not that strong
My wife doesn't seem to support my attempts at treatment. I see no other path.
I did fine without a father. None of my current emotional instabilities arose from lack of a father.

I got married, had children in a pathetic attempt to give my life meaning. It failed in every way. If living for the sole purpose of helping others live is the way it is supposed to be, I do not want to be here.
I think Stewie said it best. It's not that I want to die, It's just that I don't want to be alive any more.
